Project Manager:in - Marktpartner (w/m/d)

 - Du koordinierst die Umsetzung von Projekten zwischen externen Marktpartner:innen und internen Fachbereichen und hast jederzeit den Überblick über Aufgaben, Timings und Verantwortlichkeiten.

title: Product Manager Energy Markets & Flexibility (m/f/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°
 At  1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision:  Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?  
 We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective.  
 By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia. 
 Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow . 
Your mission
 Conceptualization & Expansion of Energy Market Solutions:  Development and operational establishment of scalable models for balancing group management (BKM), direct marketing, and flexibility optimization for our C&I and enterprise customers with multi-site portfolios 
 Tech & Market interface:  Close collaboration with our software and product teams to further develop our virtual power plant ( Heartbeat AI Enterprise ) – defining functional requirements for aggregation, dynamic flexibility bands, and schedule setpoints 
 Partner & Trading Management:  Selection, integration, and ongoing management of external BKM and trading partners (e.g., algorithmic intraday trading companies, aggregators, transmission system operators) 
 Multi-Use Operating Models:  Design of prioritization and operational logic for commercial battery storage systems (e.g., balancing UPS/backup priority, grid-charge-optimized peak shaving, and spot market arbitrage) 
 Risk & Schedule Management:  Monitoring forecasting quality, balancing energy costs (reBAP), and schedule notifications to minimize financial risks in the balancing group 
 Regulatory Framing:  Ensuring and implementing relevant energy industry regulations (e.g., mixed storage guidelines / MiSpeL, MaBiS, Redispatch 2.0) in customer contracts and system workflows 
 Sales Support:  Support during enterprise customer pitches, creation of economic models, and design of revenue-sharing concepts (profit-split) 
Your profile
 Completed degree in energy economics, industrial engineering, electrical engineering, business administration, or a comparable qualification 
 Several years of professional experience in balancing group management (BKM), at a direct marketer, flexibility aggregator (VPP), or in short-term power trading (EPEX SPOT Day-Ahead / Intraday) 
 Sound understanding of the deployment and monetization of large-scale and commercial battery energy storage systems (BESS) as well as PV systems in the C&I segment 
 Solid knowledge of the German regulatory framework (StromNEV, EnWG, MaBiS, MiSpeL) and market communication processes 
 High affinity for software, IoT architectures, and API-driven data flows between edge gateways, VPP platforms, and trading systems 
 Strong analytical mindset, entrepreneurial drive, and structured problem-solving skills 
 Persuasive communicator at eye level with enterprise customers and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork 
 Business fluent in German and English, both spoken and written 
Benefits
 You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
 With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
 Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
 You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
 You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
 You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
 Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
 Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
 Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

title: Product Manager -  Administration & Governance
description:
About Supabase
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Product Manager, Administration & Governance to join our Product Team and make Supabase the default starting point for software built inside a company.
Supabase already spreads from the bottom up: someone has an idea, creates a project, and builds something useful. Inside most companies, Supabase starts the same way: someone has an idea, creates a project, and builds something useful. The next step is making that momentum company-wide: one platform where anyone can start building, and where IT can see what’s running, who owns it, and what it costs.
You’ll own how companies run Supabase as their internal development platform: approved by IT and easy for anyone in the company to use. You’ll make it possible for people and the agents they work with to start building without waiting on infrastructure, while giving platform, IT, and security teams the controls they need to say yes. The goal is to make the approved path the easiest path, from an early experiment to a production application, with the controls companies need built in.
WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR
 - Own the product strategy and roadmap for internal innovation, from a company’s first IT-approved rollout to adoption across teams and business units.
 - Make getting started self-service, whether someone creates a project in Supabase, through an internal developer portal, or with an agent. Give builders the access and infrastructure they need without a ticket for every project.
 - Steer scattered usage into a manageable company-wide platform. Give companies one view of everything they run on Supabase. Shape how ownership, delegated access, and boundaries work so teams can move independently as usage grows.
 - Partner closely with platform, IT, security, and finance teams to understand what it takes to approve Supabase and keep it approved. Translate their needs into practical identity, policy, audit, and spend controls that don’t slow builders down.
 - Define the path from experiment to production, including project ownership, access, and the guardrails that change as an application becomes important to the business.
 - Work with Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success to turn early customer rollouts into a repeatable experience, rather than a new custom integration for every company.
 - Define what success looks like, instrument it end to end, and let the data guide what gets built next—from time to first project and self-service adoption to production usage and expansion across the company.
YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU
 - Have 7+ years of product management on developer tools, infrastructure, or internal developer platforms.
 - Have built self-service products that developers love and platform or IT teams trust. You understand both the person trying to ship an app and the team responsible for how it runs.
 - Can reason about identity, permissions, organization boundaries, and usage attribution, and turn those systems into workflows people can actually understand.
 - Have a strong point of view on how agents change who can build software inside a company and what an internal development platform needs to make that possible.
 - Know your way around controlled experimentation and data analysis, and can connect easier adoption to sustained product use.
 - Are biased toward speed and would rather ship, learn, and iterate than perfect a spec.
 - Build with what you own and form opinions through first-hand use, from creating a project to configuring the policies around it.
 - Use AI tools to compress research, drafting, and feedback synthesis so you can focus on judgment calls.
 - Work async by default, making decisions in writing in a fully remote team.
WHAT WE OFFER
 - Fully Remote
 We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.
 - ESOP
 Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
 - Tech Allowance
 Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.
 - Health Benefits
 Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
 - Annual Off-Sites
 Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
 - Flexible Work
 We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
 - Professional Development
 Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
ABOUT THE TEAM
Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.
 - ~400 team members
 - 60+ countries
 - 20+ languages spoken
 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)
 - 540,000+ community members
We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Staff Product Manager  - Preply Pro and Strategic Projects
description:
WE POWER PEOPLE’S PROGRESS.
At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.
We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.
Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.
THE ROLE
This is an opportunity at Preply to lead the launch of Preply Pro - our AI-first freemium experience - and to own the strategic, cross-cutting projects that move the whole business forward.
You will lead a portfolio of high-leverage initiatives that span multiple squads and tribes. These are the problems that matter most to Preply but don't sit neatly inside one team - commercial, cross-functional, and often ambiguous. It's some of the highest-visibility work at Preply and a core part of how we turn strategy into shipped, measurable outcomes.
We're looking for someone who combines depth in product building with sharp commercial instincts, exceptional stakeholder management and disciplined execution - comfortable operating without a dedicated squad, and energised by bridging the gap between product management and program management to get big, ambiguous things over the line.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY
 - Own the Preply Pro launch end to end. Strategy, roadmap, execution, and commercial results for one of Preply's most important bets - across squads, learners and tutors, web and mobile.
 - Lead the commercial story. Own the business case, pricing and packaging, and the metrics that prove Pro is working. You bring commercial judgement to every prioritization call, not just product craft.
 - Work across squads and tribes. The highest-impact work rarely lives in one team. You'll shape and drive initiatives that cut across multiple squads and tribes, aligning people who don't report to you around a shared outcome.
 - Manage stakeholders like a pro. Keep senior stakeholders across Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Finance and Ops aligned and moving - building trust, surfacing trade-offs early, and driving decisions without formal authority.
 - Stay close to the customer. Keep deep empathy for learners and tutors at the centre of every decision, so every strategic bet solves real problems people feel.
 - Execute with discipline. While having access to product resources, you will operate without a dedicated squad - bridging product and program management to turn ambiguous, cross-functional work into clear plans, owners, and shipped results.
 - Go into the data yourself. Pull your own analyses on how learners and tutors interact with Preply to guide decisions. Especially on Pro, what drives conversion and retention, and where the experience is falling flat.
WHAT YOU'LL NEED
 - Senior product craft. Substantial experience building and launching consumer-facing, mobile-first products. You have a keen eye for design and care about the details of a delightful experience.
 - Strong commercial acumen. You are energized by driving user and business outcomes - pricing, packaging, conversion, retention, unit economics - and can build and defend the business case for a launch like Preply Pro.
 - Deep customer empathy. You are genuinely curious about the learners and tutors who use Preply, and bring that into every prioritization call.
 - Deeply data-driven. You go into the data yourself, find the signal, and build a point of view from scratch. You're comfortable with experiment design and reading A/B results without fooling yourself.
 - Stakeholder management & influence. You build trust fast and align senior stakeholders across functions who don't report to you, turning competing priorities into shared decisions.
 - Strong communication. You can turn complex, ambiguous work into a clear point of view that drives decisions at the leadership level.
 - Disciplined execution. You turn ambiguous, cross-functional work into clear plans, owners, milestones and shipped outcomes - bridging product and program management.
 - Comfort with ambiguity. You can make fuzzy things measurable and drive alignment on what good looks like - and you're comfortable delivering without a dedicated squad, borrowing and influencing resources to get there.
 - Experience launching or scaling monetization related products
OUR PRINCIPLES
 - Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
 - We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
 - Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
 - Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
 - Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
 - Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
 - Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

title: Associate Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
**At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.**
Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for **10,000+ businesses worldwide**, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, **millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day**.
We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.
We're **100 people**, **profitable**, and have raised **€18M in funding** (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.
We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.
In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.
We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.
#### **Learn how product is built from the inside, working side by side with our CPO.**
*As our Associate Product Manager, you'll work directly with our CPO as a force multiplier for the product team. You'll take on high-impact work across customer research, product data, product marketing and adoption - topics that span the whole product org rather than a single product area.*
#### **Who We Want**
**Hungry learner** 
You're eager to learn fast, actively seek feedback and turn it into visible progress within weeks, not months.
**Structured self-starter** 
You're highly organized, bring order to messy situations and get things done without step-by-step guidance.
**Analytical thinker** 
You're comfortable with data and can pull numbers from spreadsheets or analytics tools and turn them into clear insights.
**Customer-curious** 
You enjoy talking to users, ask good follow-up questions and turn interviews into actionable takeaways.
**Clear communicator** 
You write crisply, build clean slides and feel comfortable presenting to customers, e.g. in webinars.
**Scrappy generalist** 
You're happy to switch between product marketing, data, research and ops, and no task is "beneath you".
**AI-native** 
You use AI tools daily to work faster and better - from research and data analysis to drafting content and slides - and you're always experimenting with new ones.
**Has taste** 
You have a strong sense for what good looks like in product, design and writing, and you notice when something feels off, even if it's "technically fine".
**Language** 
You're fluent in English, written and spoken.
#### **Who We Don't Want**
* You only want "pure PM" work like roadmaps and specs and aren't interested in marketing or customer-facing tasks
* You need a lot of structure and clear processes to be productive
* You struggle to communicate clearly in English, in writing or in front of an audience
* You get defensive when receiving feedback
* You see this mainly as a title step rather than a chance to learn and get hands-on
**Your Day to Day** 
Strategic Projects (~25%)
* Work directly with our CPO on the topics that matter most right now
* Prepare leadership meetings, drive decisions forward and make sure priorities turn into results
Product Marketing & Launches (~35%)
* Plan and run initiatives that bring our product to customers: webinars, product updates, customer events, newsletters and educational content
* Prepare and launch new features end-to-end together with Product, Engineering and Marketing
* Build sharp slides and reports for customers and leadership
Customer Research (~20%)
* Run customer interviews and turn what you hear into clear insights for the product team
* Feed those insights into roadmap decisions together with our PMs
Product Analytics & Adoption (~20%)
* Own dashboards on activation and adoption and turn the numbers into actions
* Drive initiatives that improve activation and adoption of key features
**Stakeholders**
**Product Managers:** Feed customer insights and data into roadmap decisions and support with research, specs and launch prep 
**Engineering & Design:** Clarify requirements, gather product feedback and coordinate release timing for launches 
**Customer Success:** Identify customers for interviews and work together on onboarding, activation and adoption initiatives 
**Sales:** Build enablement material and slides, and align on positioning and messaging for new features 
**Marketing:** Co-own product launches, webinars, release content and campaigns 
**Customers:** Run interviews and webinars, collect feedback and turn it into insights for the team
#### **Why People Choose Us**
* We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We're an in-office culture at heart - we genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.
* We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work toge

================
Cosuno is the marketplace where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, and subcontractors find and win new projects. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform. 
We see several ways to grow from here, such as new modules for existing customers or customer segments we don't serve yet. As our Senior PM for Growth, you'll own one of these opportunities and you'll help choose the next. Next to that, you'll take care of the day-to-day product work in your area.
**What you'll do**
==================
* **Find the real problem.** Talk to customers, many of whom aren't tech-savvy, dig into our data and work out who has the problem, how much it matters and what we need to build.
* **Put AI to work.** Construction still runs on a lot of manual work. You'll find where AI can replace it and turn that into products customers love.
* **Test before you build.** Prototype and run small experiments with real customers before Engineering commits, then ship with Design and Engineering.
* **Bring it to market.** Launch with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, from positioning and pricing to enablement, and measure what it brings in.
**After one year,** you've taken your first opportunity to real customers, you're working on your second, and the new offerings bring in measurable revenue.
**How we work**
===============
* **Full ownership.** You own your growth opportunity end to end, from the first customer conversation to the revenue it brings in. Design and Engineering build with you.
* **Close to the customer.** You'll talk to customers constantly.
* **Fast and data-driven.** We ship every two weeks, test ideas before we build them and judge every launch by its numbers.
* **AI-first.** We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day. For every opportunity, your first question is: where can AI take manual work off our customers' hands?
**What you bring**
==================
* 3–5 years as a product manager in B2B SaaS, and you want to stay hands-on
* You've taken a new revenue opportunity (a module, upsell, segment or market) from idea to a product customers pay for
* You've shipped AI features that customers actually use, and you use AI tools every day in your own work
* You work with numbers and experiments, and you change course when the data says so
* You explain complex things simply, to a site manager as well as to management
* German at C2 level and fluent English: our customers work in German, our engineering team in English
* Experience with two-sided marketplaces, or with construction or another industry that is just going digital.
**Why us?**
===========
* **Real impact:** You own a growth opportunity, with short decision paths to our Head of Product, and you see the result in our numbers.
* **A head start:** Your first opportunity is prepared for you, so you can get going from day one.
* **Competitive compensation:** A salary above the market average.
* **Work-life balance:** Work fully remotely from anywhere in Europe, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg.
* **Top-notch equipment:** A new MacBook Pro.
* **A great team:** Regular company off-sites and team events.
* **Job security:** A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.
* **Growth & feedback:** An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.
**About us**
============
Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology. 
We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity. 
Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs. 
But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An inclusive work environment is a given for us. 
Join us – Build the future of construction.

title: (Senior) Product Owner - Platform Engineering (m/f/d)
description:
Our Ideal Match
 We are looking for a Product Owner who takes product areas on our B2B platform from the first problem to what thousands of SMEs end up using. Perseus is a Berlin cybersecurity company of around 35 people. We help insurers and their SME customers manage cyber risk, today in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, France, Spain, and the Netherlands, with more markets planned for 2027. Our product team is small and was set up as a team of its own only recently, so you will shape a lot. You report to the CPO and work closely with him; you and our engineering lead get your areas built together: you own the what and why, engineering owns the how.
 What You Will Be Working On
 Own product areas on the platform: understand the problem, decide what we build, write the requirements, and follow changes through release and into real use.
 Define roadmap themes and outcome goals together with the CPO and internal stakeholders.
 Order and refine the work on your areas with engineering: you lead refinement and decide the order, engineering owns the technical solution and challenges scope and feasibility early.
 Give the engineers requirements they can build from and fast answers when something is unclear.
 Work with the people closest to our users: customer success, sales, our security experts, partners, and the users themselves.
 Shape and keep improving the way we develop products, from the first request to the release.
 Desired Experiences & Skills
 Experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager working directly with a software engineering team.
 Given a problem, you work out several ways to solve it, test them against data and user feedback, and turn the best one into a concept.
 You work independently and keep the CPO informed on your own initiative, including the decisions you take.
 You plan your work and say early when a date is going to slip.
 Strong communication skills in English; German is a plus.
 We fill this role at regular or senior level. Senior means several years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, a product area you have run on your own. From the start the larger areas, their roadmap with the CPO, and the partner conversations about them will be in your own hands.
 Nice To Have
 Experience with B2B platforms, partner-driven business models (B2B2B), or the insurance or cybersecurity sector.
 Consulting experience.
 Hands-on experience with AI tools in product work.
 The following exciting tasks await you…
 Taking over live product areas and shipping your first changes within a few weeks.
 Building new products for our insurance partners and their SME customers, expanding the platform we have.
 Using AI tools in daily product work and pushing them further with us.
 Sitting in on partner conversations with some of Germany's largest insurers.
 You're a perfect match for us because…
 You want to own an area and answer for the result.
 You care whether a release changed something for the user, not only whether it shipped.
 You see engineers as partners in finding the solution, not as a delivery team.
 You set a high standard for your own work.
 You want to help reduce cyber risk for thousands of SMEs through a product with purpose.
 Why you will love Perseus...
 A transparent, open company culture with direct communication and real impact.
 A diverse and committed team built on trust, collaboration, and shared purpose.
 A centrally located office in Berlin-Kreuzberg plus flexible working hours and remote options.
 Regular professional development and personal growth opportunities.
 Strong employee benefits such as EdenRed, mobility budget, team events, and more.
 Permanent contract, start as soon as possible.
 About Us
 Perseus Technologies was founded in 2017 in Berlin and has since specialized in helping companies protect themselves against cyber threats. Our mission is to support especially small and medium-sized businesses in identifying, assessing and effectively managing digital risks.
We offer a comprehensive cybersecurity solution that covers both technical and organizational aspects, including:
 Risk assessments to evaluate IT and security infrastructure
 Online trainings and phishing simulations to educate employees on handling digital threats safely
 24/7 cyber emergency support, in case something goes wrong despite all precautions
 Many of our solutions are easy to integrate into existing systems and help organizations build a sustainable cybersecurity culture.
A unique aspect of our approach is our close collaboration with the insurance sector: Today, Perseus is included in nearly every second cyber insurance policy on the German market.
We are currently a team of around 35 employees from various national backgrounds — international, committed and united by strong teamwork.
Our name is inspired by Greek mythology: Just as the hero Perseus faced dangerous creatures, we tackle new digital challenges every day — with determination, pragmatism and a strong team by our side.

 Work hand-in-hand with the IKGs Tech Lead and the R&D team to translate roadmap into requirements, sprint goals, and measurable releases

 Track record of delivering high-quality features that meet novel customer needs and balancing the needs of multiple consumers in a highly dynamic environment 
 Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to think outside the box – roll up your sleeves to ship 
 Strong abilities to manage internal stakeholders, surface use cases, and drive consensus across engineering, product, and partner organizations

title: Product Owner / Business Analyst – Immobilienbewertungssoftware LORA (m/w/d)

Erfurt, Berlin, Essen, Hamburg, Leipzig, München
Vollzeit
Festanstellung

------------------

**Dein neuer Job** 
* Du analysierst und bewertest Anforderungen und Geschäftsprozesse unserer Kunden aus der **Immobilien-, Banken- und Versicherungsbranche**.
* Du entwickelst neue **Produktideen und Funktionen für LORA** und bringst Deine eigenen Impulse in die Weiterentwicklung der Software ein.
* Du übersetzt Kundenanforderungen und Produktideen in **fachliche Konzepte und konkrete Anforderungen** für die Entwicklung.
* Du begleitest neue Anforderungen und Funktionen von der ersten Idee über die Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung.
* Du pflegst und priorisierst das **Product Backlog** und sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen klar und nachvollziehbar beschrieben sind.
* Du stimmst Dich regelmäßig mit **Kunden, internen Stakeholdern und dem Entwicklungsteam** ab.
* Als Teil unseres **agilen SCRUM-Teams** arbeitest Du aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung von LORA mit.
* Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei fachlichen Fragestellungen und stellst sicher, dass Kundenanforderungen in passende Lösungen übersetzt werden.
* Mit Deinen Ideen trägst Du dazu bei, **LORA und die dahinterliegenden Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern**.
**Dein Profil**
---------------
* Du bringst idealerweise 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Product Owner, Business Analyst, im Produktmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit.
* Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Immobilienwirtschaft, Wirtschafts-, Ingenieur- oder Naturwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung im Finanz-, Immobilien- oder Versicherungsumfeld abgeschlossen.
* Idealerweise hast Du bereits Erfahrung oder Berührungspunkte mit Immobilienbewertung, Immobilienfinanzierung oder Softwarelösungen im Immobilienumfeld.
* Du hast Spaß daran, Geschäftsprozesse zu analysieren, Anforderungen zu strukturieren und daraus konkrete Lösungen zu entwickeln.
* Du bist IT-affin, interessierst Dich für Software und bringst idealerweise Grundkenntnisse im Bereich Webanwendungen und Apps mit.
* Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest strukturiert und selbstständig und bringst gleichzeitig Kreativität und Offenheit für neue Ideen mit.
* Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und Entwicklungsteams gehören zu Deinen Stärken.
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau sind für diese Position erforderlich; gute Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.
**Warum wir?**
--------------
* Hybrides Arbeiten – Ob im Büro in Erfurt, an weiteren Standorten oder überwiegend remote: Wir finden gemeinsam das Modell, das zu Dir und Deiner Lebenssituation passt
* Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe – Bei uns ist das „Du“ selbstverständlich, unabhängig von Rolle oder Position
* Regelmäßige Team-Events – Gemeinsam Erfolge feiern und auch außerhalb des Arbeitsalltags Zeit miteinander verbringen
* Gesundheit & Ausgleich – Wir unterstützen Dich mit Angeboten rund um Bewegung und Wohlbefinden
* Weiterentwicklung – Du bekommst Raum, Dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln
* Work-Life-Balance – Familie, Freizeit und Beruf in Einklang zu bringen ist für uns selbstverständlich
* Teamspirit – Offene Zusammenarbeit, kurze Entscheidungswege und echtes Miteinander im Alltag
**Über uns**
------------

Founded in Berlin, autarc is a ~75 person start-up who were part of Y Combinator's S24 batch in San Francisco. Our team consists of people in Sales, Tech and Operations.

* Strong analytical skills and confidence working with KPIs, systems and operational detail
* Excited by AI tooling, automation and how modern teams can move faster with the right setup
